goal: Build 'Freelancer-Profit-Calculator', a CLI tool that calculates freelancer profit margins, effective hourly rates, and estimated tax liabilities based on CSV imports of revenue and expenses.
acceptance_criteria: Tool reads CSV with columns: date, type (income/expense), amount, description
Tool calculates total revenue, total expenses, net profit, and profit margin percentage
Tool estimates tax liability based on provided tax rate or default 25%
Tool outputs a formatted summary table to the console
Tool writes a detailed report to logs/profit_report.txt
